{{Top|leg}}
'''Ansmul-hide''' was a type of [[Leather/Legends|leather]]. The [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and jackets made of ansmul-hide waterproofed with the digestive juices of [[Slar]] were popular in the local communities of [[Port Evokk]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
